items.title: Review third-group profile and freeze next facts/search route

acceptance: Review covers all three semantic subgroups before any implementation change
Valid decisions include retain/merge/rename/modifier/INCONCLUSIVE/continuous-facts-only

No attempt is made to force six passing labels
